scope: Proposition 5.1 (Smooth annuli with repeated choices) of the manuscript “Annular variation of the triangular Hilbert transform at the symmetric point” (preprints/Annular-variation-of-the-triangular-Hilbert-transform-at-the-symmetric-point-October-5-2026/annular-variation.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 082 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 f5857c58037fa528), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 17. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let Gv ∈ C∞ c (R2) be complex. At each output pair (a, b), make a step choice of at most n ≥ 1 disjoint radius intervals (εj, Rj) and coefficients |βj| ≤ 1. For Ka,b(t) = ∑︂ j βjIεj,Rj (t) one has |ΛK(G0, G1, G2)| ≤ C √ n 2 ∏︂ v=0 ∥Gv∥3. The constant is independent of the step partition, the menu of choices, and all endpoints.
